CustomField.description: A partner's opportunity counts as a booking on the portal once its Stage comes after this stage in the order of the Opportunity Stage picklist. Without a stage that exists and is active, nothing counts as a booking.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Opportunities in a stage after this one (in the Stage picklist order) count as bookings on the portal. Enter the stage as it appears in the picklist.
CustomField.label: Bookings After Stage
